title: Shadows
examples: Teacher, why do shadows change size?
Can shadows happen when it is cloudy?

explain.say: Some things block light when it hits them.
Where the light is blocked, there is a dark shape. It is called a shadow.
When the Sun is high in the sky, shadows are short.
When the Sun is low, in the morning or evening, shadows are long.
Look at your shadow at different times of day. It changes size.

faq.a: The Sun seems to move across the sky as the Earth turns. When the Sun is low, the light comes in at a slant and makes long shadows.
asks: Does the sun's position change shadow size?

faq.q: Can I make a shadow without the sun?
faq.a: Yes. You can use a torch or a lamp to make shadows indoors.
asks: Do I need sunlight for shadows?
Can I use a torch for shadows?

faq.a: Shadows are shortest when the light source, like the sun, is directly overhead in the sky. This usually happens near noon.
asks: At what time are shadows shortest?

faq.a: A shadow is simply the area where an object blocks the path of light. It is not a real thing, but an absence of light.
asks: What is a shadow made of?

faq.q: Does the time of day change the shadow?
faq.a: Yes, the time of day changes the shadow greatly. In the morning, shadows are long, and at noon, they are short.
asks: What happens to shadows over the day?

facts: A shadow is formed when an object blocks light.
Shadows are longest in the early morning and late afternoon.
Shadows are shortest when the light source is highest.

quiz.say: The Sun is just rising. What will your shadow look like?
quiz.why: A low Sun makes long shadows.

wrong.1: Short shadows come when the Sun is high, near midday.
wrong.2: The Sun is shining, so you still have a shadow.

quiz.why: Around midday the Sun is highest, so shadows are shortest.

wrong.0: In the early morning the Sun is low, so shadows are long.
wrong.2: In the evening the Sun is low again, so shadows are long.

quiz.say: You stand in front of a torch beam. What do you make on the wall?
quiz.why: Your body blocks the light. That makes a shadow.

wrong.0: A rainbow needs water drops to split the light.
wrong.1: Your body blocks the light, so there is less light there.
